setup: Owned synthetic public timing probe under existing strace with fsync/fdatasync only. No buffers, paths, credentials, live-process attachment or changed WAL/durability. Diagnostic timestamps correlate syscall duration to transaction windows. Shared host lock spans native command and cleanup; root grants window after M4.
cleanup: Wrapper finally closes/removes synthetic DB and owned XDG state. Retain diagnostic trace/log/JSON on failure. No production process termination.
rollback: Diagnostic records and wrapper only; no application changes, no threshold change or delivery acceptance relaxation.
